prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. A cabinet door opens and a hand reaches confidently for the exact jar it needs — it is there, front and center. The camera follows a fast, joyful assembly: pasta into a dish, sauce ladled in spirals, cheese falling like snow. Money shot: the dish pulled from the oven bubbling at the edges, macro on the gratin crust crackling and pulling. Final beat: two forks diving in from opposite sides at once, a happy standoff. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the jar landing on the counter, then the bubbling crust. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
Sabe o ingrediente que SEMPRE falta na hora H?

Quando a lista de compras nasce do cardápio, ele nunca mais fica pra trás. O prato favorito da casa, sem a volta ao mercado.

Manda pra quem sempre esquece uma coisa 👇
